text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text: Trainer, this way.

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
It's beautiful, isn't it?
Pansies and violas—winter flowers in full bloom.

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
“Still, the sunlight is already
clad in the glittering radiance of spring—”

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text: I wanted to hand it to you in this very place.

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
...Happy Valentine's.
I wrapped this for you.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I receive the beautifully wrapped package,
accompanied by a bouquet of dried flowers.

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
No.
I hope it suits your taste.

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
"...――
Both the 'Sweetpea Stakes' and the 'Tenno Sho (Spring)',
I was always springing things on you suddenly and taking you by surprise..."

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text: "Perhaps I've been taking advantage of your kindness a little too much."

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text: Thank you, as always.

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text: ...Phew—

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
(She seemed... pleased.
Today went well—I'm sure of it.)

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text: ...Hehe. I'm so glad—

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: Oh! Judging by that look, was it a huge success?

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Good work, Bouquet-chan ♡
You worked so hard for today, didn't you!
Fufu. I was so curious that I just had to come watch.

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
My—Curren-chan.
Thank you so much for coming all the way from the Ritto dorms.

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
"You've listened to so many,
so very many of my troubles, haven't you?"

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: Really? All I did to help was suggest a few scenarios, right?

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: "Spending days practicing making sweets, or—"

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
(—Hmm...
The balance feels a bit off after all.)

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
(Next time, let's try using
a little less cream.)

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Going around to multiple stores
just to find the right wrapping paper and ribbons.

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
"Considering the balance with the sweets,
sky blue, cobalt blue...
No, perhaps navy."

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text: "The wax paper would look lovely too if you match it with the outer packaging's color."

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text: "Um, Curren-chan. Would it be alright if we stopped by that general store over there, too?"

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
You made dried flowers for Valentine's Day
too, didn't you?

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
Yes. I wanted to arrange a bouquet of flowers
that matches the image of sweets.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, so meticulous down to the smallest detail, and so careful.
It was almost like gently wrapping a delicate flower.

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text: ...Indeed—

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
If the gift itself is the focal mass flower,
then the wrapping and ribbon are the filler flowers,
and the setting and your words are the line flowers.

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
In flower arrangement,
the flowers supporting the main centerpiece are essential, irreplaceable.

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
The colors woven by that harmony
can drastically change how brilliantly a memory shines.

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
I... really wanted to give you
something truly special, no matter what.

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
"Something truly extraordinary,
that you'll surely never forget."

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
"...――
Hehe, I see."

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text: Trainer...?

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Ehh?! Speak of the devil!?
What is it, what is it?!

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text: ("Thank you for the wonderful sweets today. I was so happy, and they were delicious.")

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
(“Let's give it our all again tomorrow.
Aiming for that one and only Spring Shield.”)

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text: ...Fufu. That is a wonderful answer.

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
Here is the bouquet—
...Trainer-san?
choice_data_list: Sorry for calling you out of the blue.

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
No—
Um, what is the matter?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Perhaps this is something I really should be telling them before tomorrow's training.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
However, the present I received today
was so remarkably, breathtakingly beautiful.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: A white macaron garnished with blue edible flowers—the delicate packaging combined with the dried flowers was truly a work of art.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Just how much time did it take
to prepare this gift?
choice_data_list: Thank you for the wonderful gift.

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text: —No.

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
(The effort was nothing—
Before I knew it, I was completely absorbed.)

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
(I wonder how I can paint it
so that it lingers in your heart...)

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text: If it brought you joy, there is nothing that could make me happier.
